body:
Scoped structural negative result; **no new kappa or supplier**. In the fixed binary star-reader model on the 120 real E8 root lines, no deletion of at most **55** lines improves the copy-cost/live-port ratio **63/111**. This extends Chi Zhao's PR631 exclusion through 35 punctures and Philipp's PR875 equality analysis at 36.

The new mechanism is a shared-deletion constraint. Two distinct nonzero readers have support union at least 84, while a surviving rank-d reader occupies at most M_d root lines. Thus their ranks a,b satisfy `M_a + M_b >= 84-p` after the same p deletions. Exact integer relaxation gives universal star-cost bounds **53 for p=36–43, 45 for p=44–51, and 44 for p=52–55**, all too expensive to improve 63/111. These relaxed costs are not claimed attainable. At 56 deletions the live label rank can decrease, so the theorem stops there.

Only `research/e8-joint-reader-bound/` is added: written proof, complete exact certificate, two implementations, meaningful negative controls, retained source pins, attribution and local claim. PR875's exact orbit and stronger equality-class invoice remain distinct contributions. Neither existing generators nor `upstream/` nor the selected frontier is changed.

Reproduce offline with Python 3.10+ and the standard library:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/e8-joint-reader-bound/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_E8_JOINT_READER: 256 flats; 511 readers; 130305 pairs; punctures 0..55; 6 rejection controls; no new kappa`.

Validation passed on CPython 3.14.6 and 3.12.12. An implementation importing neither the primary checker nor predecessor code independently reconstructs the root capacities with Fraction RREF and checks 486,200 sorted-rank profiles. All five package tests pass, including evidence/source corruption rejection, isolated optimized relocation, byte-identical regeneration and the pinned PR631 replay/controls. A staged Git-tree export passes both new checkers under `-I -O -B`; selected-record integrity and whitespace checks pass. Full repository/supplier cold replays and hosted CI are not claimed for this isolated package.

Exact base: **91a2094f2e022930069e8cfdc810a3ea1b81cd09**. OS assignment seed **46**, structural decoder track. PR631 is pinned to `fb893b5ee1317c2da3b297e6fe78eca0857d1a76`; PR875 context to `7f334e4c749fd83d03feb6c1de4e4cda9534c9dc`, with verified Git-blob/SHA256 pins. The final full overlap inventory covered 706 open PRs through #934, followed by a recent-PR refresh through #937. No pinned coordination issue existed, so the claim/result are local. Upstream advanced during verification to `47481c89fd30a43f8f882eb4b391e89c29273fd0`, selecting PR890 at conditional kappa 0.001661957774647029; this structural theorem is independent of that update.

Scope remains fixed root-only labels, independent input bits and additive star copy-rank accounting. General pairing-rank/nonlinear decoders, non-root ports, 56+ punctures, helper savings and changed geometry remain open. The written parabolic coverage proof is essential; finite enumeration is not a formal multiplication theorem. All-size/compiler, hosting, precision/tape and analytic obligations remain inherited.

Credit **Chi Zhao/PR631**, **Philipp (@mightyOil)/PR875**, **Joel Pulikkan/GamingPuzzled/PR620**, **DreamingOfClouds/PR595/PR602**, **eumemic/PR543** and the earlier E8 lineage. Prepared by **Ross Richardson (@RossRichardson)** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance**, including separate AI-assisted checking and proof review. Apache-2.0; no independent human review claimed.
title: Scoped negative result: E8 star-copy ratio cannot improve through 55 punctures (no new kappa)
